title: Advisor Diagnosis
description: Canonical structural mirror of the AdvisorDiagnosis Pydantic model at src/gzkit/complexity/advisor/diagnosis.py (ADR-0.0.29 / OBPI-0.0.29-01). The data contract every downstream OBPI in ADR-0.0.29 binds against; consumers MUST validate against this schema rather than re-deriving the shape. Cross-field constraints (end_line >= start_line) are enforced by Pydantic only — JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 has no portable cross-field comparator.

crossing_band.description: Threshold band the metric crossed. One of the three trigger-semantic values.

crossing_value.description: Observed metric value that triggered the diagnosis.

proof.description: Non-empty array of file-range proof items for this diagnosis.

intrinsic_attestation.description: Optional intrinsic attestation reference; populated by OBPI-07.

RefactorArchetype.description: Canonical ten-value refactor archetype enumeration. Amendments require ADR-0.0.29 ceremony.

authority.description: One of the four canonical doctrinal authorities.

citation.description: Free-form citation string (book title, chapter, page).

excerpt.description: Brief excerpt from the cited authority supporting the diagnosis.

file_path.description: Relative path to the source file (from repo root).

start_line.description: First line of the proof range (1-indexed, inclusive).

end_line.description: Last line of the proof range (1-indexed, inclusive). Must be >= start_line (enforced by Pydantic only).

ast_node_kind.description: AST node kind at this range (e.g. 'FunctionDef', 'ClassDef').

attestation_id.description: Opaque attestation identifier; resolved by OBPI-07.
